levels.name: The Forgotten Oasis
levels.objective: Find the bronze key and open the eastern portal.

camp.name: Caravan camp
camp.description: A brazier lights your camp. West is a ruined well. East stands a sealed stone arch. A tablet invites you to explore together.

features.tablet: One explorer can fetch the key while another studies the arch. Meet to SHARE ITEM bronze key WITH <name>.

well.name: Dry well
well.description: A bronze key lies among the reeds. The camp lies east.

arch.name: Portal arch
arch.description: An empty keyhole marks the arch. The inscription reads: TURN KEY, then follow the eastern portal.

features.inscription: The bronze key turns the portal's lock.

puzzles.response: The arch fills with starlight. A portal opens east.
hints: Find the key by the well.
Carry the bronze key to the arch.
